A '''Sorin v3 Avalon''' was a model of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]].

==History==
The podracer [[Skall Delos]] owned a modified v3 Avalon during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It had slim, triple engines that were painted red and blue-colored cockpit, that was furnished with [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] hide. He used the pod in the [[Cularin Swamp Run/Legends|Cularin Swamp Run]], a race on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. However, [[Alina Impeveri]] caused the pod to crash during the race, destroying it.
